head:
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0b0908">
<style id="sigil-partner-terms-v6-css">
#sigil-partner-terms-v6{
  --ink:#171311;
  --paper:#f4eee6;
  --paper-2:#fffaf4;
  --night:#090908;
  --night-2:#11110f;
  --panel:#171714;
  --gold:#caa260;
  --gold-hi:#f0d09b;
  --ivory:#fff8ee;
  --body-dark:#d9d2c8;
  --muted-dark:#aaa39a;
  --body-light:#5e554f;
  --line-dark:rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --line-gold:rgba(202,162,96,.34);
  --shadow:0 28px 72px rgba(0,0,0,.20);
  width:100%;
  min-height:100vh;
  overflow-x:clip;
  background:var(--night);
  color:var(--ivory);
  font-family:"LINE Seed Sans TH","Noto Sans Thai",system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 *{box-sizing:border-box}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 img{display:block;max-width:100%}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 button,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 input{font:inherit}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 em,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 i{font-style:normal}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-wrap{width:min(100%,1220px);margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-kicker{
  margin:0;
  color:var(--gold-hi);
  font-size:10px;
  line-height:1.3;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.16em;
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-kicker-gold{color:#8c6427}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-btn{
  min-height:50px;
  padding:0 18px;
  border-radius:999px;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:8px;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:800;
  transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease,background .22s ease;
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-btn-light{background:var(--ivory);color:#241b12;box-shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-btn-dark{background:#1c1713;color:var(--ivory);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(42,29,17,.14)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-btn-outline{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:var(--ivory)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-btn:focus-visible,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-dashboard-link:focus-visible,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-brand:focus-visible,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-branch a:focus-visible,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-accept-btn:focus-visible,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-check input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-hi);outline-offset:3px}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-nav{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:90;
  top:0;
  left:0;
  right:0;
  height:64px;
  padding:0 14px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:14px;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,8,7,.92),rgba(8,8,7,.52),transparent);
  transition:background .25s ease,border-color .25s ease,backdrop-filter .25s ease;
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-nav.is-scrolled{
  background:rgba(9,9,8,.92);
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:var(--ivory);font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;white-space:nowrap}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-brand-mark{width:23px;height:23px;border:1px solid var(--line-gold);border-radius:7px;position:relative;background:rgba(202,162,96,.08)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-brand-mark:before,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-brand-mark:after{content:"";position:absolute;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transform-origin:left center}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-brand-mark:before{width:17px;left:4px;top:7px;transform:rotate(35deg)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-brand-mark:after{width:15px;left:6px;top:15px;transform:rotate(-41deg)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-dashboard-link{
  min-height:40px;
  padding:0 12px;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:7px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(15,15,13,.54);
  color:var(--ivory);
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:800;
  white-space:nowrap;
}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero{
  position:relative;
  min-height:760px;
  height:100svh;
  max-height:940px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:#080807;
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-img,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-img{object-fit:cover;object-position:62% center;transform:scale(1.018);transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6.is-ready .pt6-hero-img{transform:scale(1)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-overlay{
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,7,6,.18) 0%,rgba(7,7,6,.12) 32%,rgba(7,7,6,.64) 70%,rgba(7,7,6,.97) 100%),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(7,7,6,.68),transparent 72%);
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;padding-top:104px;padding-bottom:38px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-copy{max-width:720px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero h1{
  margin:10px 0 0;
  color:var(--ivory);
  font-size:clamp(48px,13vw,76px);
  line-height:.94;
  letter-spacing:-.052em;
  font-weight:900;
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero h1 em{display:block;color:var(--gold-hi)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-lead{max-width:650px;margin:17px 0 0;color:rgba(255,248,238,.84);font-size:15px;line-height:1.72}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:22px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-text-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:rgba(255,248,238,.86);font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:26px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-meta span,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-meta b,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-meta small{display:block}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-meta span{color:var(--gold-hi);font-size:8px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-meta b{margin-top:4px;color:var(--ivory);font-size:13px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-hero-meta small{margin-top:3px;color:rgba(255,248,238,.60);font-size:10px;line-height:1.35}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-branch{
  position:sticky;
  z-index:70;
  top:64px;
  background:rgba(12,12,10,.94);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-branch-track{
  display:flex;
  gap:7px;
  overflow-x:auto;
  padding:10px 12px;
  scrollbar-width:none;
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-branch-track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-branch a{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  min-height:38px;
  padding:0 12px;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#d6cec4;
  background:#141411;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.04em;
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-branch a.is-active{border-color:var(--line-gold);background:rgba(202,162,96,.10);color:var(--gold-hi)}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro{padding:72px 0;background:var(--paper-2);color:var(--ink)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-grid{display:grid;gap:28px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-media{
  position:relative;
  min-height:420px;
  margin:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  border-radius:28px;
  background:#1a1714;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-media img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:420px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 35%}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-media:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 58%,rgba(8,8,7,.82) 100%)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-media figcaption{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:18px;right:18px;bottom:17px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-media figcaption span,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-media figcaption b{display:block}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-media figcaption span{color:var(--gold-hi);font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-media figcaption b{margin-top:4px;color:var(--ivory);font-size:13px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-copy{align-self:center}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-copy h2,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-section-head h2,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-copy h2{
  margin:9px 0 0;
  color:var(--ink);
  font-size:40px;
  line-height:1.01;
  letter-spacing:-.045em;
  font-weight:900;
}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-copy h2 em,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-section-head h2 em{color:#8d6729}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-intro-copy>p:not(.pt6-kicker),
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-section-head>p{margin:15px 0 0;color:var(--body-light);font-size:14px;line-height:1.76}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-type-mini{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:20px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-type-mini>div{padding:15px 16px;border:1px solid rgba(23,19,17,.10);border-radius:17px;background:#f7f0e8}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-type-mini span{color:#96703a;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-type-mini b{display:block;margin-top:5px;color:var(--ink);font-size:16px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-type-mini p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#6a605a;font-size:12px;line-height:1.58}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model{padding:72px 0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-dark{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b0b09,#11110f);color:var(--ivory)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-grid{display:grid;gap:28px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-media{position:relative;min-height:440px;margin:0;overflow:hidden;border-radius:28px;background:#171512;box-shadow:0 28px 75px rgba(0,0,0,.20)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-media img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:440px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 32%}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-copy{align-self:center}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-dark .pt6-model-copy h2{color:var(--ivory)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-dark .pt6-model-copy h2 em{display:block;color:var(--gold-hi)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model:not(.pt6-model-dark) .pt6-model-copy h2 em{display:block;color:#8d6729}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-copy>p:not(.pt6-kicker):not(.pt6-note){margin:15px 0 0;color:var(--body-light);font-size:14px;line-height:1.76}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model-dark .pt6-model-copy>p:not(.pt6-kicker):not(.pt6-note){color:var(--body-dark)}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-rate-card{margin-top:22px;padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(202,162,96,.22);border-radius:22px;background:rgba(202,162,96,.06)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-rate-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding-bottom:13px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-rate-head span{color:#aaa39a;font-size:11px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-rate-head b{color:var(--gold-hi);font-size:13px;text-align:right}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-rate-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:13px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-rate-grid>div{padding:11px 12px;border-radius:13px;background:#161613;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-rate-grid span{color:#c5beb5;font-size:11px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-rate-grid b{color:var(--gold-hi);font-size:14px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-rate-card>p{margin:13px 0 0;color:#aaa39a;font-size:11px;line-height:1.65}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:22px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card>div{padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(23,19,17,.10);border-radius:16px;background:#fffaf4;text-align:center}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card span,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card b{display:block}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card span{color:#8d6729;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card b{margin-top:5px;color:var(--ink);font-size:14px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card>i{display:grid;place-items:center;color:#956b28;font-size:20px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card .is-final{background:#241b14}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card .is-final span{color:var(--gold-hi)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-flow-card .is-final b{color:var(--ivory)}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation{margin-top:22px;padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(202,162,96,.22);border-radius:22px;background:rgba(202,162,96,.06)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation>span{display:block;color:#aaa39a;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation>b{display:block;margin-top:5px;color:var(--gold-hi);font-size:19px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation-example{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:17px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation-example p{margin:0;padding:11px 8px;border-radius:13px;background:#161613;text-align:center}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation-example strong,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation-example small{display:block}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation-example strong{color:var(--ivory);font-size:13px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation-example small{margin-top:4px;color:#8f8981;font-size:8px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation-example i{color:var(--gold-hi);font-size:15px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation-result{margin-top:10px;padding:12px 13px;border-radius:13px;background:#1a1916;color:#c9c2b9;font-size:12px;text-align:center}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-equation-result strong{color:var(--gold-hi)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-note{margin:14px 0 0;padding:13px 14px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;background:rgba(202,162,96,.06);color:#a9a298;font-size:11px;line-height:1.68}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-model:not(.pt6-model-dark) .pt6-note{background:#f0e5d8;color:#6d6057}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-dashboard{padding:74px 0;background:var(--paper-2);color:var(--ink)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-section-head{display:grid;gap:14px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-dashboard-grid{display:grid;gap:9px;margin-top:24px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-dashboard-grid article{min-height:150px;padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(23,19,17,.10);border-radius:18px;background:#f7f0e8}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-dashboard-grid span{color:#8d6729;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-dashboard-grid b{display:block;margin-top:15px;color:var(--ink);font-size:17px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-dashboard-grid p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#6a605a;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-dashboard-cta{margin-top:18px}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-agreement{padding:74px 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0a09,#12110f);color:var(--ivory)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-section-head-dark h2{color:var(--ivory)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-section-head-dark h2 em{color:var(--gold-hi)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-section-head-dark>p{color:var(--body-dark)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-terms-layout{display:grid;gap:18px;margin-top:26px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-terms-list{display:grid;gap:9px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-terms-list article{display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:17px;background:#151512}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-terms-list article>span{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line-gold);background:rgba(202,162,96,.08);color:var(--gold-hi);font-size:10px;font-weight:900}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-terms-list b{display:block;color:var(--ivory);font-size:14px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-terms-list p{margin:5px 0 0;color:#aca59c;font-size:12px;line-height:1.68}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-accept{padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--line-gold);border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1d1a15,#11110f);box-shadow:0 28px 75px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-accept h3{margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--ivory);font-size:26px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.035em}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-accept>p:not(.pt6-kicker){margin:10px 0 0;color:#c9c1b8;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-status{margin-top:18px;padding:13px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:15px;background:#0d0d0b;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-status-dot{width:9px;height:9px;margin-top:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#807a72;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.03);flex:0 0 auto}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-status b,
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-status small{display:block}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-status b{color:var(--ivory);font-size:12px}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-status small{margin-top:3px;color:#99928a;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-status.is-ready .pt6-status-dot{background:#b8d4ad;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(184,212,173,.08)}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-status.is-error .pt6-status-dot{background:#d8a28e;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(216,162,142,.08)}

#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-check{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin:17px 0;color:#c9c2b9;font-size:11px;line-height:1.66;cursor:pointer}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-check input{margin:3px 0 0;accent-color:var(--gold);flex:0 0 auto}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-check input:disabled{cursor:wait}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-accept-btn{width:100%;min-height:58px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:16px;background:var(--gold);color:#171109;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .22s ease,opacity .2s ease}
#sigil-partner-terms-v6 .pt6-accept-btn:not(:disabled):hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  var root=document.getElementById("sigil-partner-terms-v6");
  if(!root||root.dataset.init==="1")return;
  root.dataset.init="1";
  root.classList.add("is-enhanced");

  var WORKER_BASE=(root.getAttribute("data-worker-base")||"").replace(/\/$/,"");
  var TERMS_VERSION=root.getAttribute("data-terms-version")||"modeling_partner_terms_v3_2026-09-20";
  var DASHBOARD_PATH=root.getAttribute("data-dashboard-path")||"/partner/dashboard";
  var params=new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var token=params.get("t")||"";
  var reduced=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  var nav=root.querySelector("[data-pt-nav]");
  var status=root.querySelector("[data-partner-status]");
  var statusTitle=root.querySelector("[data-partner-status-title]");
  var statusCopy=root.querySelector("[data-partner-status-copy]");
  var check=root.querySelector("[data-terms-check]");
  var button=root.querySelector("[data-accept-terms]");
  var message=root.querySelector("[data-terms-message]");
  var tokenLinks=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("[data-token-link]"));
  var branchLinks=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("[data-branch-link]"));
  var sections=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("[data-section]"));
  var busy=false;
  var verified=false;

  function setStatus(mode,title,copy){
    if(!status)return;
    status.classList.remove("is-ready","is-error");
    if(mode)status.classList.add(mode);
    if(statusTitle)statusTitle.textContent=title||"";
    if(statusCopy)statusCopy.textContent=copy||"";
  }

  function setMessage(text,mode){
    if(!message)return;
    message.classList.remove("is-ok","is-error");
    if(mode)message.classList.add(mode);
    message.textContent=text||"";
  }

  function syncButton(){
    if(!button)return;
    button.disabled=busy||!verified||!token||!check||!check.checked;
    button.setAttribute("aria-busy",busy?"true":"false");
  }

  function dashboardFallback(){
    var url=new URL(DASHBOARD_PATH,window.location.origin);
    if(token)url.searchParams.set("t",token);
    return url;
  }

  function safeDashboard(value){
    try{
      var url=new URL(value||DASHBOARD_PATH,window.location.origin);
      if(url.protocol!=="https:")return null;
      if(["mmdbkk.com","www.mmdbkk.com"].indexOf(url.hostname)<0)return null;
      if(url.port||url.username||url.password)return null;
      if(url.pathname!=="/partner/dashboard")return null;
      if(!url.searchParams.get("t")&&token)url.searchParams.set("t",token);
      if(url.searchParams.get("t")!==token)return null;
      return url;
    }catch(_error){
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function fetchJson(url,options,timeoutMs){
    var controller="AbortController" in window?new AbortController():null;
    var timer=controller?setTimeout(function(){controller.abort();},timeoutMs):null;
    var opts=Object.assign({},options||{});
    if(controller)opts.signal=controller.signal;

    try{
      var response=await fetch(url,opts);
      var payload=await response.json().catch(function(){return null;});
      return {response:response,payload:payload};
    }finally{
      if(timer)clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }

  function bindTokenLinks(){
    tokenLinks.forEach(function(link){
      var path=link.getAttribute("data-path")||DASHBOARD_PATH;
      try{
        var url=new URL(path,window.location.origin);
        if(token)url.searchParams.set("t",token);
        link.setAttribute("href",url.pathname+url.search);
      }catch(_error){
        link.setAttribute("href",DASHBOARD_PATH+(token?"?t="+encodeURIComponent(token):""));
      }
    });
  }

  async function verifyAccess(){
    verified=false;
    if(check){
      check.checked=false;
      check.disabled=true;
    }
    syncButton();

    if(!token){
      setStatus("is-error","เปิดจาก Partner Access ส่วนตัว","ใช้ลิงก์เดิมที่ได้รับจาก SĪGIL เพื่ออ่านและยืนยัน Terms");
      setMessage("เมื่อเปิดจาก Partner Access ระบบจะตรวจสิทธิ์ให้โดยอัตโนมัติ","is-error");
      return;
    }

    setStatus("","กำลังตรวจ Partner Access","ใช้เวลาเพียงครู่เดียวครับ");
    setMessage("");

    try{
      var result=await fetchJson(
        WORKER_BASE+"/v1/partner/verify?t="+encodeURIComponent(token),
        {method:"GET",headers:{Accept:"application/json"},cache:"no-store"},
        12000
      );

      if(!result.response.ok||!result.payload||result.payload.ok!==true){
        var errorMessage=result.payload&&result.payload.error&&(result.payload.error.message||result.payload.error.code);
        throw new Error(errorMessage||"Partner Access ต้องตรวจสอบอีกครั้ง");
      }

      verified=true;
      if(check)check.disabled=false;
      setStatus("is-ready","Partner Access พร้อมแล้ว","อ่าน Terms ให้ครบ แล้วติ๊กยืนยันเพื่อเข้าสู่ Partner Dashboard");
      setMessage("");
      syncButton();
    }catch(error){
      verified=false;
      if(check)check.disabled=true;
      setStatus("is-error","ลิงก์นี้ต้องตรวจสอบอีกครั้ง","เปิด Partner Access จากลิงก์ล่าสุดที่ SĪGIL ส่งให้คุณ");
      setMessage(error&&error.name==="AbortError"?"การตรวจสิทธิ์ใช้เวลานานกว่าปกติ ลองเปิดลิงก์นี้อีกครั้งครับ":"Partner Access ยังไม่พร้อมสำหรับการยืนยัน Terms","is-error");
      syncButton();
    }
  }

  async function acceptTerms(){
    if(busy||!verified||!token||!check||!check.checked)return;
    busy=true;
    syncButton();
    setMessage("กำลังบันทึก Terms V3 เข้ากับ Partner Access ของคุณ…");

    try{
      var result=await fetchJson(
        WORKER_BASE+"/v1/partner/accept-terms",
        {
          method:"POST",
          headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json",Accept:"application/json"},
          body:JSON.stringify({
            t:token,
            agreement_version:TERMS_VERSION,
            accepted_at:new Date().toISOString(),
            source_path:window.location.pathname
          })
        },
        15000
      );

      if(!result.response.ok||!result.payload||result.payload.ok!==true){
        var errorMessage=result.payload&&result.payload.error&&(result.payload.error.message||result.payload.error.code);
        throw new Error(errorMessage||"ยังบันทึก Terms ไม่สำเร็จ");
      }

      setMessage("บันทึก Terms แล้ว กำลังเปิด Partner Dashboard","is-ok");
      if(button){
        var label=button.querySelector("span");
        if(label)label.textContent="บันทึก Terms แล้ว";
      }

      var next=safeDashboard(result.payload.dashboard_url)||dashboardFallback();
      window.setTimeout(function(){window.location.assign(next.toString());},450);
    }catch(error){
      busy=false;
      syncButton();
      setMessage(
        error&&error.name==="AbortError"
          ?"ใช้เวลาบันทึกนานกว่าปกติ ลองกดอีกครั้งได้เลยครับ"
          :"ระบบยังบันทึก Terms ไม่สำเร็จ ลองอีกครั้งหรือเปิด Partner Access จากลิงก์ล่าสุด",
        "is-error"
      );
    }
  }

  function setupBranchNav(){
    branchLinks.forEach(function(link){
      link.addEventListener("click",function(){
        branchLinks.forEach(function(item){item.classList.remove("is-active");});
        link.classList.add("is-active");
      });
    });

    if(!("IntersectionObserver" in window)||!sections.length)return;

    var observer=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      var visible=entries
        .filter(function(entry){return entry.isIntersecting;})
        .sort(function(a,b){return b.intersectionRatio-a.intersectionRatio;})[0];

      if(!visible)return;
      var id=visible.target.id;
      branchLinks.forEach(function(link){
        link.classList.toggle("is-active",link.getAttribute("href")==="#"+id);
      });
    },{rootMargin:"-28% 0px -58% 0px",threshold:[0,.15,.35,.6]});

    sections.forEach(function(section){observer.observe(section);});
  }

  function setupReveal(){
    var nodes=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".pt6-reveal"));
    if(reduced||!("IntersectionObserver" in window)){
      nodes.forEach(function(node){node.classList.add("is-visible");});
      return;
    }

    var observer=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(entry){
        if(entry.isIntersecting){
          entry.target.classList.add("is-visible");
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    },{threshold:.08,rootMargin:"0px 0px -7% 0px"});

    nodes.forEach(function(node){observer.observe(node);});
  }

  function setupNav(){
    function update(){
      if(nav)nav.classList.toggle("is-scrolled",(window.scrollY||0)>42);
    }
    update();
    window.addEventListener("scroll",update,{passive:true});
  }

  if(check)check.addEventListener("change",syncButton);
  if(button)button.addEventListener("click",acceptTerms);

  bindTokenLinks();
  setupBranchNav();
  setupReveal();
  setupNav();
  verifyAccess();

  requestAnimationFrame(function(){root.classList.add("is-ready");});
})();
</script>

PARTNER AGREEMENT · V3

ข้อตกลงที่ควรรู้
ก่อนเริ่มทำงานด้วยกัน

ข้อตกลงนี้ใช้กับบัญชี Partner ของคุณ ส่วนรายละเอียดเฉพาะของ Model หรือแต่ละโปรเจกต์ จะดูได้ใน Partner Dashboard

01
งานเสร็จและชำระครบ

ค่าตอบแทนจะยืนยันเมื่องานเสร็จ ลูกค้าชำระครบ และรายการนั้นพร้อมสรุป

02
ใครแนะนำใคร

ระบบจะบันทึกว่า Model คนไหนมาจากคุณ ทำงานกันในรูปแบบไหน และใช้เรทอะไร เพื่อให้ทุกฝ่ายอ้างอิงข้อมูลเดียวกัน

03
ข้อตกลงเฉพาะงาน

บางงานอาจมีราคา หรือ % แบ่งกำไรเฉพาะโปรเจกต์ ให้ยึดข้อตกลงล่าสุดที่ยืนยันไว้สำหรับงานนั้น

04
ดูแลข้อมูลกันเป็นส่วนตัว

ข้อมูลของ Model ลูกค้า งาน และราคา ใช้เฉพาะเท่าที่จำเป็นกับงาน และควรเก็บเป็นเรื่องส่วนตัว

05
สรุปรายได้จากข้อมูลที่ยืนยันแล้ว

ยอดรายได้จะสรุปจากข้อมูลงานและการชำระเงินที่ระบบยืนยันแล้ว
